# Unpause (https://playunpause.com)

> Independent, unofficial second-screen gaming companion for console and PC players. Designed to deliver exact calculations in under 3 seconds while your game is paused on a phone or desktop—zero pop-up ad clutter, zero mandatory sign-up walls, zero bloated SEO filler.

## Supported Games & Companion Utilities

### 1. Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI) — Est. & Pre-Launch Preview
- **Console Preload & Storage Spec (`https://playunpause.com/`):** Adjustable storage estimator (community estimate: 212 GB PS5 / 225 GB Xbox Series X|S, optional +35 GB Day-1 Patch buffer) across Series S (512 GB / 1 TB), Series X (1 TB), PS5 Base (825 GB), PS5 Slim (1 TB), and PS5 Pro (2 TB). Includes download ETA by Mbps, New Zealand rolling unlock estimates (Nov 18 @ 11:00 UTC NZ vs Nov 19 Global), and Preload Spec Card PNG export.
- **Safe & Door Keypad Vault (`https://playunpause.com/?tab=safes`):** Instant district search, interactive matte hardware 10-key playback with 1-tap mobile & desktop clipboard copy, and local completion checklists (6 fictional UI preview demo safes shown pre-launch; verified codes update live starting Nov 18).
- **Squad Heist Cut & Two-Character Stock Planner (`https://playunpause.com/?tab=squad`):** Integer-exact squad split calculator with NPC fee deduction, per-player lock toggles, assigned roles, Crew Payout Slip export, and story stock compounder (UI preview gameplay math only).
- **Weeknight Routes & Missables Shield (`https://playunpause.com/?tab=nightrun`):** Free 45-minute express run + interactive Leonida route grid and spoiler-free pre-launch preview pause alerts (90m & 120m extended chains and cross-device sync included with the Sync Pass, updating live at release).

### 2. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 & Warzone (Season 1)
- **MW4 / Warzone TTK Comparator (`https://playunpause.com/?game=cod-warzone`):** Named Season 1 weapon presets (Cronen Osprey, Axion, ISO Nightshade, VEL 46, WZ.55 Striga, KG-7 Vulcan), A vs B TTK comparison, chest vs headshot zones, open-bolt delay toggle, and selectable HP (300 / 250 / 200 / 100).
- **Mastery Camo Tracker (`https://playunpause.com/?game=cod-warzone`):** Class-aware milestone tracking across 33 launch weapons.

### 3. Fortnite: Battle Royale
- **Multi-Mode Battle Pass XP Pace (`https://playunpause.com/?game=fortnite`):** Tracks Level 100/140/200 targets at 80,000 XP/level with daily mixes across BR Daily Bonus Quests, UEFN Creative, LEGO/Festival playtime, and Weekly quests.

### 4. Minecraft (Java & Bedrock)
- **Nether Portal 8:1 Coordinate Linker & 2nd-Portal 3D Collision Check (`https://playunpause.com/?game=minecraft`):** Exact `Math.floor` division for negative coordinates, Java vs Bedrock search radius parity, 3D Euclidean neighbor portal collision check (`<= 128` Overworld / `16` Nether), plus Chunk & `.mca` Region Finder.

### 5. EA Sports FC 27 (Ultimate Team)
- **5% Transfer Market Tax, Price-Step Sniping & 11-Player SBC Solver (`https://playunpause.com/?game=ea-fc-27`):** Exact 5% EA tax, FUT market step-snapped break-even sell targets, multi-card quantity batches, and exact 11-player SBC Excess-Rule rating solver.

### 6. Roblox (Developer Exchange & Marketplace)
- **30% Marketplace Fee, 30,000 R$ Threshold Guard & DevEx USD Tiers (`https://playunpause.com/?game=roblox`):** Applies `$0.0038/R$` Standard, `$0.0035/R$` Legacy, and `$0.0054/R$` US 18+ Direct Store rates, enforces the 30,000 R$ minimum payout floor, and computes reverse Gamepass listing prices.

### 7. Counter-Strike 2 (CS2)
- **MR12 Loss-Bonus Ladder & 5-Player Bank Matrix (`https://playunpause.com/?game=cs2`):** Models `$1,400–$3,400` loss progression (Pistol loss starting Level 1 `$1,900`, round wins stepping down -1 tier), T (`+$800` plant) vs CT equipment budgets, and 5-teammate drop balancing.

### 8. Valorant
- **Round Buy Matrix & Ranked RR Simulator (`https://playunpause.com/?game=valorant`):** Real credit economy planner (`3,900` Rifle + Heavy, `3,300` Rifle + Light, `1,900–2,900` loss streak floor) paired with Win-Rate RR promotion simulation.

### 9. Apex Legends
- **500-Pack Heirloom Pity Breakdown & Ranked RP Ladder (`https://playunpause.com/?game=apex-legends`):** Calculates free packs across Tier 0 (Levels 1–500, 199 free packs) and Prestige 1–3 (+345 packs = 544 total) alongside Ranked RP entry-cost vs placement match estimators.

### 10. GTA Online (GTA V)
- **Cayo Perico Payout Splitter & Loot Bag Planner (`https://playunpause.com/?game=gta-v`):** Enforces GTA's mandatory `15%` crew floor (`85/70/55%` max host split), Pavel 2% + Fencing 10% deductions, Primary Target + Hard Mode + Secondary Bag Fill combinations.

## Unpause Sync Pass ($6.99 USD Founders before Nov 18 11:00 UTC / $9.99 Standard)
- Optional one-time purchase with zero recurring billing (Merchant of Record: Whop Inc., excluding applicable VAT/GST/sales tax calculated at checkout; 14-day hassle-free refund policy): unlocks instant QR & `UP-XXXXXXXX` cross-device cloud sync across phone & desktop, unlimited saved watchlists/pins, extended 90m/120m GTA VI weeknight chains & Acts II–III Missables Shield (preview, live Nov 18), and top sponsor-bar removal.
